records.label: Consanguineous family with moderate ID

variants.as_reported: homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform

quotes: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems, we identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform of the same gene, which represents the first reported familial mutation in the ANK3 gene.

records.label: Patient with balanced translocation

variants.as_reported: balanced translocation disrupting all isoforms of the ANK3 gene

quotes: In a patient with a borderline intelligence, severe attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism and sleeping problems, all isoforms of the ANK3 gene, were disrupted by a balanced translocation.

notes.statement: Hu et al. (2019) performed whole exome and whole genome sequencing in 404 consanguineous, predominantly Iranian families with 2 or more affected offspring with intellectual disability. They found likely causative variants in 219 families, involving 77 known and 77 novel autosomal recessive ID (candidate) genes, 21 X-linked genes, and 9 genes previously implicated in diseases other than ID.
quotes: we report on whole exome and whole genome sequencing in 404 consanguineous predominantly Iranian families with two or more affected offspring
In 219 of these, we found likely causative variants, involving 77 known and 77 novel AR-ID (candidate) genes, 21 X-linked genes, as well as 9 genes previously implicated in diseases other than ID.

notes.statement: Iqbal et al. (2013) found memory defects in a Drosophila knockdown model of the ANK3 ortholog, which supported the causality of the ANK3 mutations in the two families and a role for the gene in cognitive function.
quotes: The causality of ANK3 mutations in the two families and the role of the gene in cognitive function were supported by memory defects in a Drosophila knockdown model.
